title: flashLocus: exact and fast fine-mapping, colocalization and linkage disequilibrium in Rust
description: Rust implementation with Python bindings that reproduces susieR 0.14.2 (susie_rss), coloc 5.2.3 (coloc.bf_bf as used by coloc.susie) and PLINK 1.9 genotype correlation. Includes regression tests, benchmark scripts and the data and scripts for the manuscript figures.
